notes.title: Rekindling Revamped! 1.0 Release coming soon!
notes.content:
Hey guys HUGE NEWS. We have been hard at work totally revamping the entire game to finally get us out of early access and into the full release world! A lot has gone into this from redrawing over 2,000+ individual art assets, Overhauling the whole AI system for Survivors, Zims and animals, and so much more. Lets take a sneak peek at some of it!


 New Graphics
We have brought an artist onto the team to help us totally reimagine what Rekindling could look like. No longer do we just have bobbling around creatures with floating heads, we now have fully animated dynamic survivors! We have taken this whole redesign very seriously and replaced pretty much every single asset currently in the game with an updated new one!

New Survivor, Zim and Animal logic
Survivors and Zims used to do some pretty silly things when it came to their internal logic without going into a lot of super nerdy things here we have totally rewritten a lot of how they make decisions to be more intelligent and feel more "alive"

New survivors!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/d46c03c25005c86da9caa46bdd04ba1fd43deb78.gif
LOOK BEHIND YOU!!!

Just so much more
Leading up to launch in the next few months we will do more posts with deep dives into some of the new features!

 Revamped Research progression.
 Full controller support for 'Control' mode with a revamped control mode.
 New Zims.
 More ways to control your settlement and survivors.
 Totally rethought UI.


So when is it happening!?!?
I am notorious at giving specific dates on things and missing them so what I will say is we are aiming to release this update along with a bump from early access into full release in Q3 of this year! So stay tuned. Feel free to let us know any questions you have or just share you excitment here on the steam forums or on our Discord

notes.title: Update .80. Farming re-work and tons of improvements!
notes.content:
Hey guys!! Long time without an update. Hope it was worth the wait. We changed a ton of big and little things behind the scenes in this update. Lets get into some of the bigger changes.


Farming rework
One of larger changes this update is how farming is treated. previously you would start the game with ALL of the farming options already unlocked. This would be very confusing as you don't know what you should or shouldn't be growing. Farming plots now must be researched per crop you are trying to grow! Lots of crops have been sprinkled through the tech tree, as well we have added a new category of 'Farming' to the bottom of the tech tree. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/8a1650a199a0eca266ea2b2149bd7266507ff544.png

Ease of use improvements
The biggest complaint about Rekindling has always been its hard for new players to figure out what is going on. As such we have put a lot of effort into trying to streamline some things such as help tooltips and guiding the user to show them when something is happening in their colony. On top of that we have added new sections to the help menu for new players to learn more of the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/3fbfde4e5b89796511983f5fced4cbed5880910d.png

Supply drops
A new random event of 'supply drops' have been added! This is another way for your settlement to get some much needed supplies before you have researched things. Supply crates and luggage will now fall from the sky occasionally grant you a multitude of fresh equipment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/77a12401049e52e6f5a8a5fb5a83295b9ff555b2.png

More complex survivors
We have added a ton more random traits, professions and backstories for survivors to help give more variety when deciding to accept survivors into your settlement or not. From Pet lover to Frail your survivors will have some more uniqueness to them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/58dbd7b337fcf7a468d89884113d280e927cff22.png

Behind the scenes fanciness
As always we have been working on our game engine powering Rekindling FreakingSweet almost non stop. Rekindling is now only our second game to be upgraded to be using FreakingSweet 2.0 with only our other newest release Goo Gladiators using it, this opens a ton of potential for thing in the future such as better online interactions and even cross platform play!

 Final Thoughts 
Thank you guys for showing support for Rekindling for all these years! This was a nice size update, but we had to delay a lot of the features we had planned for it. A lot of framework things are now firmly in place to get the the 'end game'. My goal is to start to button up a few more features (multiplayer, survivor control, ect..) to get us ready for a 'full release' sometime hopefully in the near future. As always please feel free to let me know what you would like to see next or what you think of the game either in a Steam Review, the Steam Forums or over on our Discord!

notes.title: Update .79. Blood Moons, new Zim Types & more.
notes.content:
Lots of new features and fixes in this one! So strap in. Also In the effort of trying to be fancier I also made a video summary here: 
[previewyoutube=qPN4Db8_owc;full][/previewyoutube]


For those of you who prefer to read....

 Blood moons 
Every 15 days in game now there will be a BLOOD MOON. The BLOOD MOON, has a significantly increased Zim spawn rate and you need to prepare in order to survive the night!!

 New Zim variant: Oozers 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/28057d910bb085bfd3ce89df0a77bdaae7bf7939.gif

A new type of zim is on the prowl! Oozers are slightly weaker and slower than normal Zims however they drop a toxic purple ooze on death. This ooze will taint the ground and slowly spawn zims on that tile, Even during the day!

 Lightning rods 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/0e151865e96911b2e0b1365486f7d5e86dfca77c.gif

A few things have been added to help reduce the devastation of forest fires. Firstly we have added a new building, Lightning rods! They cover a large area and will direct lightning to them instead of nearby forests and structures. As well ash that is left in a burnt forest will slowly replant trees in the surrounding areas.

 Combat AI reworks 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/4de9b242a502fecd8fbb176bb03d8ffacbce2180.gif

Lots of little things have been added to tweak the survivor AI. One of these is survivors will now be more directly responsive when a friend is being attacked by a zim. As well survivors will give up on impossible jobs much more quickly than they used to.


 Leaderboard reset!! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/cc5b8f63e3a24958cfa97cd34792e7facd22ecff.png

Breaking Mastergamings commanding grip on the top leaderboard scores. We have reset the leaderboard and put a new champion! The difficulty has changed with blood moons and the new Zim type hence the change. The next champion spot is up for grabs!

 Final Thoughts 

As always thank you guys so much for the continued support! More updates are still in store for Rekindling as the game grows. As always feel free to leave us a review on Steam or hop in the discord to let us know what you want to see next or even just your thoughts on the update.

notes.title: Update 0.77 Mech suits & performance Improvements
notes.content:
Hey guys! New update is out. Tons of new stuff from new equipable mech suits to things falling from the sky! Lets go over some of the highlights.


Mech Suits
We have added a new way to protect your survivors and improve their work output! Rideable mechs.
Mechs are crafted at the new building the V-Bay. In future you will be able to craft other vehicles at this station. After they are crafted you can assign a survivor to one and they will enter it. Once inside the vehicle will enhance their work output as well as serve as a protective barrier from enemies!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/7ac0b8aeb53f61bb4da0b662c1615a26df0ca6ad.png


Item textures revamp
As the game grows older some of the old textures for items looked not up to standard with the rest of the game. As such we went through all of the items in the game and re-drew and touched up the majority of them. Some of the changes can be spotted just from the start!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/3c62437c111fdda6ba1290142caf09c5df68e39d.png

Objects from space!
New random events have been added. Space debris will now fall from the sky. This will be yet another source of renewable metal. However be careful as it will destroy structures and start fires on impact!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/d605709a648b500c051c0f23b5499e8a23db4996.gif

Performance improvements
A deep dive on things that would cause the game to drop below 60 FPS was done and a ton of improvements have been made. The power network had a massive backend overhaul and now runs significantly better. As well the power view mode would cause lag on large bases in previous updates, It now runs at a crisp 60 FPS!
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/860e79aa2f8f7fec50470375980852e9880a3b23.png

Final thoughts
The update finally got here! Sorry for the delays lots of things have been coming up recently that have made it harder to get things done on Rekindling. Plenty more is planned for Rekindling that didn't make the cut this update, but is already half done, such as transport belts and automated buildings! Thank you guys for your continued support as always let us know what you think of the game and the update via the Steam forums, Discord or with a Steam Review (those help us out a ton :) ) and of course if you are feeling extra generous to support our projects check us out on Patreon

notes.title: Update 0.76 Power and Security.
notes.content:
Lots of fun reworks and better ways to control your settlement this update!

Security
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/c4865d05f77a0fa6a626699d17bdebee1629c423.png

We have made it easier to make your survivors be safe at night! Survivors will only do jobs at night that are designated in the 'safe areas'. To aid in this we have added an new 'safe area' view mode that shows safe areas, as well we have added a new 'Security tab' in the bottom right. In future this tab with also contain survivor patrols and other fun things revolving around safety. 

Power Reworks
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/df109d131931d0df7f45633ac361e3720ffc6a6d.png

The way power works has also been changed. We have completely removed wires and now have a new item called "Power node" Power nodes are automatically connected to your power grid and give an aura nearby of what they are also connecting to the network. All powered items need to be connected to the grid in order to function. We have also reworked the power view mode to help you see at a glance what is on the grid and how much power your power items have.


Spiffing up of menus 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/c70490aef4f63bb430c27379041af80c614d8a58.png

We have started to overhaul the look and feel of a lot of the menus. as you can see the main menu looks completely different. Many of the icons for menus and such have changed in the main menu as well as in game. We have more we want to do with it, but its off to a good start.

 Final thoughts 
As always guys keep the feedback coming. Tons of more content is in the works for Rekindling and we prioritize what to work on first based on user feedback! Thanks for all the continued support, make sure to let us know what you think on our Discord or here on steam in a Steam review, or in the forums.

notes.title: Update 0.74 Smarter Survivors. New items, Leaderboard Reset!
notes.content:
Hey guys! Another content update has come out! We have added some new items, we have improved the combat AI for survivors, added some more sound effects and even fixed some more bugs.

Survivor AI Reworks
One of the largest impacts that you will notice is survivors will be far less aggressive with chasing random Zims on the map. They will now be a lot more conservative in their fights. This will lead to it being easy to manage settlements without your survivors going off and dying all the time!!

Science balances 
A large complaint was that science can be really hard to get started especially if you don't have a properly skilled and dedicated scientist. We have reworked a ton of the values for the first few starting science blobs. Some are cut more than 60% of what they were before!! As well we have added basic furniture on the science tab!

As well this update we have gone and fixed a ton of bugs and added some more 'ease of use' things. More sound effects and music will play at points as well as things like the scheduler showing when day and night is!

notes.title: Update 0.72 Multiplayer
notes.content:
Finally it is here!! After a ton of work we finally have Rekindling playable in multiplayer. Updates will now resume their normal speed with our next one already less than 10 days away. Do keep in mind multiplayer is an early access feature in our early access game. So expect quite a few hiccups. We have an active channel on our Discord going at it to try and find bugs and bring them to us!


Multiplayer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/ddbef417d481ab88c15b52035b2dfb54f56322ea.png

When starting a game you are now given the option to start a 'Co-op' game. Doing so will open your game up for your friends to join! Make sure you have opened a port on your router as you are hosting the server locally. The default port for Rekindling is: 62345. Once you are in the game a friend can hit join game and help you build your settlement in tandem with you! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/6ae7f6343fa99113cab8558fc8713605927747e0.png


Technical rants 
This update ended up taking a lot longer than indented. As many of you know, Rekindling runs off of our own custom game engine, as such we wanted to build a robust multiplayer framework we can use for all future games we make. We ended up restarting from scratch on the multiplayer part 3 times in the past 5 months. It has been an adventure, but the core framework there now is good and we now have a ton of room to grow and quickly add to it.

There will most likely be a ton of small updates over the coming weeks finding bugs with multiplayer and getting it to a spot where we feel comfortable with it. So bear with us and report anything you find to us here on Steam or on our Discord

Final thoughts
Thank you guys for still having interest in Rekindling. I have a lot of big plans for this game that extend pretty far into the future. As always we welcome any and all feedback so keep it coming! See you guys soon.

notes.title: Update 0.71 Shockingly Fast.
notes.content:
This weeks update brings  some new electrical defensive items as well as some major performance fixes across the board.


 Electric fences 
There is a new type of defense! Electric fences. Zims attacking the fence will damage themselves if the fence is on and powered. This makes it easier to setup a perimeter that will help you hold back the zim hordes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/290f9fad576112a5a45b836fdf7c459c144624b0.png

 Tesla Towers 
Another new turret that runs off of electricity has been added. It will zap any zims or raiders that come near to it as long as it has sufficient power! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/c7cec164a6515d0e5663a3a83e74188490af7ab2.png

 Lighting changes 
The lighting system has changed how it works a bit to allow for more variant sizes and colors based on the object glowing. For example Tesla towers and electric fences will have a small blue glow while a roaring bonfire will have a larger orange glow. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/3d4008bde188ef1474762c2b8b9e9d97257d5370.png

 Performance fixes 
We found & fixed a couple of major lag issues plaguing the game. Rekindling now handles having a large amount of jobs 3000% better (actual number). As well animal pathing was not using the fancy new pathing system added awhile back, with the addition of tamed animals that was causing issues when they had to go across the map to do jobs for the settlement. We fixed that. The animals are smarter now.

 Other helpful things
More helpful tooltips to help players better understand what is going on and why have been added. Such as 'no power' icons and warnings on buildings that are not powered.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/dfbb72e07ca429e7987d225b6390b7570521cfca.png

 Final Thoughts & next update 
Rekindling is really starting to come together! We have some fun plans for the rest of the year for Rekindling. The next update (coming in January) will be one of the largest updates to the game ever. I look forward to sharing that with you guys! Keep the feedback coming here or in our Discord channel.

notes.content:
This is a update heavy on fixes. As well we made it a lot easier to stay in control mode for longer!

Control mode revamp
Something that makes Rekindling unique is the ability to play directly as any of your survivors.
As such we spent a lot of time for this weeks update on making it so you can do a lot more while controlling your survivors. You can now manage your inventory, equip items and do building jobs while you are in control mode. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/1ddeb7a263e5d20f1fb9ecca356f962bb0602433.gif

Better item handling
Before this update if a item dropped on top of another item it would just delete the item that was trying to be placed. That is no fun! Now the item will find a nearby tile and drop it to that tile. notes.title: Update 0.64 Bows, Bears & Bugs
notes.content:
This weeks update is packed full of community suggestions! Most of the new features/improvements in this update were suggested by someone from the community. Keep the feedback and ideas coming.

 Science changes & new items
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/3623d0b4ed3bf6a4700d3f156e790082487011a6.png
We have changed the science menu to make the early game less brutal. We moved defenses down into their own section and added crossbows. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/ec5a0125c32be6505aac87f1783329ca25c5da34.png

We have also added the ability to grow grass as it is now needed as a crafting resource and needs to be renewable.

Such as making it so when you click on the controls in the top left it no long will accidentally place or select items on the world. You can read about all of these in the full patch notes below.

This was a fun update to do. A lot of what was added and fixed this update came from you guys. I appreciate all the community feedback we get on Rekindling so please keep it coming. notes.title: Update 0.63 One year in Early Access!
notes.content:
Hey guys a special update this week. Today marks one year of Rekindling being in Early access on Steam! As such we have a lot of fun things going on this week starting today with a large update. There is a lot in this one so bear with us. 

 Redone Tiles 
We have reworked the ground tiles from scratch making them look a lot less ugly an repetitive. As well as added more blending between different tile types. A picture of the difference will say more than I can so view below!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/214ec3d7c6027cdd799d56a0e45b745b25008cf1.png

 New City Environment
We have added a new starting option: City. You will have significantly fewer trees and rocks but have a lot more abandoned buildings to explore!

 New animals & animal breeding
Again this update we have added new animals. Monkeys and Tigers. Tigers are the best fighting animals in the game they will easy be able to take down a couple Zims before going down. Tigers and monkeys will only appear in the Forest & City Environments. You can now also have sustainable meat without having to run out and hunt! This is because animals will now reproduce if they are adults, haven't reproduced in awhile and have access to the new building: Troughs. You will Troughs with wheat for the animals to eat.  Crafting Priority & Crafting Fixes

Benches will now have a priority assigned to them and changing that will change the craft priority of any items made at that type of bench! Crafting also is now a lot more responsive and accurate. Queuing up 3 bats will ONLY make 3 bats instead of sometime more!

There is a three step approach to each cure trial. After researching and building a mixer and a creature vat you will unlock the cure menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/064be043157ca6e5a2e1086861477367106951e0.gif

You first must capture and analyze a zim. After this you must then pick ingredients you want to use to test a potential cure. After creating a potential cure and loading it into the vat, you will get chances to cure the Zim inside! Be careful however as a wrong cure has the potential to spawn in a very strong zim out of your vat!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/393deabbddb6624cde02c0ce894c694d50dbd113.png

 Zim changes 

Animals can now contract ZTD!!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/93c6d45141aca42a476dd808b169473317c879f7.jpg

Zims will now attack nearby animals that they hear. If the animals survive the encounter they have a chance to also turn into a Zim.

Zims as well can now live during the day if they are inside a building. This also applies to Zim animals. Be careful with animal pens as you could very well have a horde waiting in your base!

Planning
You can now plan out things before you place them! Want to make sure a space near your base is kept free for a future building? Set down some planning!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/c20b7d53a77f5d28ce8f1371221822f71aeba6c4.png 

Research balance
Research was way too easy in previous updates. Survivors could rapidly get science skill and research a late game research very quickly. This allowed people to get full research tree completion by day 14. We have significantly increased the time to research as well as reduced the amount of experience you get when researching.

Leaderboard Reset
With the addition of new threats as well as changes to research we have reset the leaderboards. Congratulations to MastergamingVR (again) for getting the top spot!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/db07c1e54694ab6ea47c416e1ea48f97d6475ce6.png

As always thank you for feedback and support! Tons of the ideas we had for this update game from talking to you guys. Keep the feedback coming. Feel free to leave us a Steam review as well those help us a ton :) This update was huge and has more than what I highlighted here, do let us know if you find any issues with it and we will get them fixed ASAP. notes.title: Update 0.58 Four new items, Three new Buildings and a lot more
notes.content:
I got a little carried away with features this week.. so bear with me we have a ton of new things.

 Cows and Butchering
Firstly we have added cows.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/41f830ac5ee74a4ad15fd16f3209e82dfd41eedc.gif

But what are cows? Just big hunks of meat? No! They are also a great source of leather.
So we have reworked how animal slaughtering works. When you kill an animal now you will get a animal corpse. You must then take that corpse to a new building, the butchers table. You have the choice in your crafting queue to turn certain animals into their respective products. All animals can be turned into meat, but you can get leather from cows and turtle shells from Turtles.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/aed9f874515403ec71f2723a777c4d67bb280aa5.gif

 Defenses
We have added some more defensive items! The only defensive item before was a turret, Turrets are expensive and require your survivors to feed them ammo. So we have added some lower level defenses. Barbed wire and a spike trap. They both are able to walked through (slowly) and will do damage to zims that walk through them. They are in their own research blob after metal building.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/c5d0d78304fa2403f83bf0b39d7ce90c354a7bf4.png

Another glaring hole in Rekindling, a zombie game, was the lack of machetes. Everyone knows you need machetes during the apocalypse. So we added them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/6a95252ee1062a567de0fd6c83b7acad2d312aad.png

 Food additions
What else are cows known for? Being in burgers. So we have added burgers to the game! With this we have added a new fast growing crop of lettuce. Lettuce provides very little hunger satisfaction, but it is used to create burgers, burgers are by far the most filling food item in the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/d8940c8ed1b805e2291f0e8309dbecc203ed802c.png

 Better management
A long requested feature has been to have single orders for crafting and not just the "Keep in storage" crafting list. Its very straight forward, your orders will be put in and done regardless of how much is in storage until all of the crafting jobs have been given out.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/9a13e6389787f50bdfd230f226fece17243d67f4.png

Next we have added additional job priorities. You want your survivors to be able to do all the jobs but prioritize certain jobs? Now you can! Survivors will look for jobs that are high priority for them then normal then low.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/53eea4fb472d7d2682d3c628ac207024018c7d09.png

As always thank you for all the feedback and support! Keep it coming, a lot of what is in this update came from you guys. Feel free to leave us feedback here on Steam in the Reviews/Forums or on our Discord. Next update is in two weeks with some more fun things and bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 0.57 Scenarios, Steam Workshop & More!
notes.content:
It has been almost a month since the last update, so we have a ton of stuff for you in this one.

Scenarios & Steam Workshop
The largest part of this update is scenarios you can not only play yourself, but make for others to play.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/31ee47ef08d13209af0ecfadb6d7a33d696edffe.png

We have made a nifty guide for anyone who would like to learn how to make and share one Here No programming knowledge or technical knowledge required!

So you don't have to wait for your friends to make scenarios we have included two pre-built scenarios you can play though. 'Overpopulation' where you start with a large amount of survivors in a small area and have to build a colony to sustain and grow them even further, And 'The Wrong Side of Town' where you find yourself berated by raiders for multiple nights in a row and must find a way to live 10 days before they kill you. 

 New and improved modes 
In order to help in the creation of scenarios we have expanded Sandbox mode to let you summon new survivors and trigger events.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/2de94f9bc994ea1a0b8b4bf1555bff7b258ff451.png
As we are transitioning sandbox mode to a more of a 'god mode' experience we wanted to also add a easier game mode than survival were you still have to work for your survivors.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/b99436be38c3b659adb56f3de7c799e927839e13.png
We have added a 'Leisure' mode that is basically a easier version of survival. Your survivors will need less food and water and you will be attacked by fewer raids and zims.

Manual jobs
For those of you that have been around awhile you know that a few updates back we added the ability to manually give jobs to survivors. Well the problem was the interface was confusing and really the only way you would find it was by accident or if you read the post. So we have made it simper by adding a button on the survivor dropdown menu 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823205/e79126ac292a9748d708410e0ad3e89275c5b4a6.png

 Improvements and bug fixes from you guys!
As always we spent a lot of time watching you guys play and listening to feedback you had about the game and we managed to fix a lot of bugs reported by you guys. Such as people getting stuck on high priority jobs that couldn't be accomplished or small things like the metal ore looking too much like the stone and scraps. As well usability things such as the hover effect being the same as the selected effect on the science menu. Overall I love interacting with you guys and seeing what you have to say about Rekindling. Keep it coming.

 Next weeks update 
There will be another update on the 28th of February with whatever feedback you guys give on Scenarios and the other new things, as well as some long awaited crafting queue reworks & job priorities per survivor. Hope to see you then, Let us know what you want to see in the game, and I am excited to see what scenarios you guys create and put on the Steam workshop!
